findings.title: Coach dashboard's "Hours by team" and "Top events by student hours" rows show raw unrounded float hours
findings.observed: "3.99999708h" rendered for both the Volt Robotics 9911 row in Hours by team and the Library STEM Night row in Top events by student hours (tests/e2e-personas/screenshots/456-coach-dashboard-scroll-3.png, captured while running this GAM-456 spec against the real seeded harness data)
findings.expected: A rounded value, e.g. "4.0h" -- the same file's own GoalProjectionRowItem (CoachHome.tsx:2188) already formats the analogous confirmed/planned/goal hours with `.toFixed(1)` a few hundred lines below these two call sites
findings.reproduction: bash tests/e2e-harness/start.sh && NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first npx playwright test -c tests/e2e-harness/playwright.personas.config.ts tests/e2e-personas/gam456-coach-home-panel-consistency.spec.ts -- then open tests/e2e-personas/screenshots/456-coach-dashboard-scroll-3.png
findings.proposedScope: Round at the format boundary only (`.toFixed(1)`, matching GoalProjectionRowItem's own precedent in the same file) for both `endContent` lines. Not GAM-456's own scope -- GAM-456 (module doc #17 in this file) only wraps these sections in `Card` and restores the H1/eyebrow styling; this float-formatting gap pre-dates that fix and was only noticed as a side effect of screenshotting these now-panelled sections for this ticket's E2E spec. Same defect class as the already-filed StudentHome.tsx raw-float finding (T808), a different file/call-site, not a duplicate.
